<!-- Build-time CMS content includes both languages; CSS shows the active one. -->

::: {.docs-faq data-src="data/docs/faq.json"}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Switch heading text in place so the TOC sees one clean node.
window.addEventListener("atlas:lang", (e) => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".docs-faq h2[data-fr]").forEach((h) => {
    h.textContent = h.dataset[e.detail] || h.dataset.en;
  });
});
</script>
```
